metadata.description: One codebase for web, Android, iOS and desktop, with a Dockerized backend behind it

plugins.name: cross-platform-init
plugins.description: Scaffolds a SvelteKit + Capacitor + Tauri codebase targeting web, Android, iOS and desktop, with a Dockerized Supabase or Postgres/MinIO backend and Redis. Includes a stack-installer agent that does the install unattended and a preflight script that reports what a machine is missing without installing anything.
